source.citation: Schell, Peterson, Vegetabile, Scherling, Smart and Morral, State-Level Estimates of Household Firearm Ownership, RAND Corporation, 2020 (TL-354): the share of adults living in a household with a firearm, 2016 estimates by state. Read from a secondary table that reproduces the RAND values (the extremes check against RAND's own coverage: Montana 66.3, Wyoming 66.2, Alaska 64.5, Idaho 60.1, New Jersey and Massachusetts 14.7, Rhode Island 14.8, Hawaii 14.9). Replace with the RAND data file when it can be fetched.

national.citation: The median of the 50 states' rates, used for the District of Columbia and the territories, which RAND's estimates do not cover.
